intro: Trying to find PhD scholarships in the USA usually means sorting through programs that look similar at first glance but differ in who can apply, what field they support, and how much documentation they ask for. This filtered slice brings together doctoral-focused listings across themes such as education, STEM, medicine, community, disability, and other areas, so you can compare options without jumping between unrelated study levels. Some rows may fit broader graduate study, while others connect more closely to teaching, health professions, engineering, business, or communication. Awards, deadlines, citizenship or residency rules, and essay expectations vary by listing, so it is worth reading each row closely before you apply.
